text:
maria: kicking off targeted canary for peko-18b (int4) — objective: baseline perf + rootcause coldstart OOMs. saw ~10-12% coldstart failures on a subset of canary hosts, traces sent to /stackdumps.
sam: is the failure during model load, prefetch allocation, or kv priming?
maria: allocator fails when allocating prefetched tensors during kv priming path; immediate GPU OOM afterwards.
kai: any common request shapes? long prompts or large max_new_tokens?
maria: yes. recurring repros are user prompt ~900-1200 tokens + default max_new_tokens 1024.
leah: 1024 default + eager prefetch is risky for 18B int4. we usually default to 256 or 512 for safety.
noah: what's current canary runtime config?
maria: service.default_max_new_tokens=1024, prefetch.enabled=true, prefetch.reserve_ratio=0.2, prefetch.strategy=eager.
sam: reserve 0.2 * 1024 = 204 tokens reserved per request; with concurrency 3 that is ~600 tokens reserved concurrently. big allocations.
kai: combined with int4 allocator slab sizes we get fragmentation and inability to satisfy medium-size allocations.
leah: propose immediate canary deltas: (1) set default_max_new_tokens=256 for peko canary; (2) prefetch.reserve_ratio=0.08; (3) switch prefetch.strategy to windowed; (4) soft-evict idle KV after 150ms.
maria: ran a short bench: old defaults (1024/0.2/eager) p50=130ms p95=720ms tokens/s=175; new defaults (256/0.08/windowed) p50=98ms p95=360ms tokens/s=215; zero OOMs in 300 runs.
noah: any quality regressions from reducing default? only affects allowed max generation length; short responses unaffected. callers needing long outputs must opt into route-level allow_long_gen.
sam: add per-route opt-in for long generations and a runtime guard: if prompt_len + requested_max_new > 1600 then require explicit allow_long_gen or route to dedicated capacity.
quant-bot: opened issue rw-quant/peko#19: "superblock allocator + int4 fragmentation" — tagging quant team for superblock tuning.
kai: medium-term: prefer pooled buffers for KV & prefetch to avoid many small allocations and adjust slab sizes for peko int4.
leah: ops checklist: (A) push canary config (maria) (B) instrument per-host fragment_ratio and OOM_count dashboards (sam) (C) add light defrag hook between heavy sessions (infra) (D) publish doc for per-route override & safety gating (leah).
infra-bot: deploy queued: canary/prefetch-tweak (job cj-5901). will emit status on completion.
sam: also add conditional compaction: if frag_ratio > 0.65 trigger compaction and reduce prefetch reserve for new sessions.
maria: repro snippet for loadtool: POST /v1/generate {"model":"peko-18b-int4","prompt":"<~1000 tokens>","max_new_tokens":1024,"prefetch":true} use concurrency=3 to repro quickly.
noah: recommendation: autoswitch to windowed prefetch for large requests (prompt + max_new > 1500) and consider gating really large requests to dedicated nodes only.
leah: I will draft a customer note about the default change and explain route opt-in.
maria: plan: roll canary change now, monitor OOM_count & fragment_ratio for 24h, then decide on wider rollout. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
